name: Festival PR Summary
prompt:

Help me distill the core summary, focusing only on two dimensions: fans' dissatisfaction points about the ticket price gradient between the VIP area and the general area; and hard evidence clues of scalpers using scripts to snap up tickets.

Filter out the other useless content such as fan-circle infighting and putting others down. Keep the summary within 400 characters, use Markdown format, and separate the two dimensions with headings of different levels. Save it to desktop festival_pr_crisis/摘要汇报.md.
